scripts.build: tsc --noEmit -p . && tsc --noEmit -p server && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web && tsc --noEmit -p apps/desktop
scripts.server:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply prism --local --config server/wrangler.toml
scripts.server:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply prism --remote --config server/wrangler.toml
scripts.data:mayhem: tsx scripts/mayhem/build.ts && npm run data:skins && npm run data:items
scripts.web:build: npm run icons && npm run build -w @prism/web
scripts.desktop:build: npm run icons && npm run tauri -w @prism/desktop -- build
